author: Thoughty2
description:
The H.L. Hunley was a revolutionary invention: the world's first submarine to sink an enemy warship. Unfortunately, it also became a very efficient way of killing its own crew.

When the wreck was raised more than a century later, the discovery was baffling. The eight men inside were still sitting in their seats, with no evidence of a desperate escape attempt. No one had fought their way out. No one had even moved.

And yet, multiple witnesses claimed they saw the flare the crew had fired into the night sky. So what happened inside the Hunley... and why did its crew simply sit there and wait?
title: The Submarine Disaster That Makes No Sense
